from openpyxl import load_workbook
from collections import OrderedDict
from pathlib import Path

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/575-16/1_575-16_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/575-16_0_bab8b8d3/1_575-16_output.xlsx"

ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Only modify the allowed answer range: G11:R13
start_row, end_row = 11, 13
start_col, end_col = 7, 18

# Clear the answer range first
for row in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    for col in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value = None

# Determine data start row
first_a = ws.cell(row=1, column=1).value
first_b = ws.cell(row=1, column=2).value
data_start = 2 if (
    isinstance(first_a, str) and "student" in first_a.lower()
    and isinstance(first_b, str) and "class" in first_b.lower()
) else 1

# Group class codes by student code, preserving the order in the source data
grouped = OrderedDict()
for r in range(data_start, ws.max_row + 1):
    student_code = ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value
    class_code = ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value
    
    if student_code is None and class_code is None:
        continue
    if student_code is None:
        continue
    
    if student_code not in grouped:
        grouped[student_code] = []
    if class_code is not None:
        grouped[student_code].append(class_code)

# Write transposed result into G11:R13:
# Column G = student code, Columns H:R = corresponding class codes
max_output_rows = end_row - start_row + 1
max_classes = end_col - start_col

for idx, (student_code, class_codes) in enumerate(grouped.items()):
    if idx >= max_output_rows:
        break
    out_row = start_row + idx
    ws.cell(row=out_row, column=start_col).value = student_code
    for j, class_code in enumerate(class_codes[:max_classes]):
        ws.cell(row=out_row, column=start_col + 1 + j).value = class_code

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
